title: When the Border Breaks Again
author: Coral Underhill
blurb: Theo Okafor, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, has spent fifteen years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
